game.title: Kabbadi (Nepali Style)
game.description: Nepali variation of kabaddi with slightly modified rules, particularly popular in rural areas and school competitions.
howToPlay: Step 1: Similar to standard kabaddi with minor rule variations by region.
Step 2: Two teams of seven occupy opposite halves of a rectangular court.
Step 3: One team sends a raider into opponent's half chanting 'kabbadi'.
Step 4: Raider attempts to tag defenders and return to their half.
Step 5: Defenders try to tackle the raider.
Step 6: Points scored for successful tags.
Step 7: Teams alternate raiders throughout the game.
Step 8: Local rules may vary regarding breathing and tackling.
Step 9: Popular in both rural and urban areas.
